svg.title: HQARRF scheduling snapshot
svg.desc: Top-down view of a 1000 by 1000 m deployment at t = 0: sensors, candidate clusters with docking points, a base station at the centre, and five chargers at the clusters they have selected. The lower level ranks docking points by attraction, repulsion and a force bonus; the upper level can redirect a charger toward an under-served zone.
